1.t: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.

1.fn: See the footnotes A, B, C, of (V.49:12).

2.t: Who has gathered wealth and counted it.

3.t: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!

4.t: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.

5.t: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?

7.t: Which leaps up over the hearts,

8.t: Verily, it shall be closed upon them,

9.t: In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars).
